task.title: Implement EW-04 inspiration graph BFF route
task.summary_zh: 把 EW-04 已發布的 inspiration graph contract 落到 BFF route、read-store 與測試，讓前端不再只有 placeholder。
acceptance: 測試涵蓋 happy path 與 degraded path
task.next: Owner finalized approved EW-04 delivery. BFF inspiration route matches the published contract, returns OBJECT_NOT_FOUND for unknown artifacts even when the dataset is missing, and the 3 EW-04 tests plus 5 PKT-003 regressions pass; only the pre-existing Pydantic dict() deprecation warning remains.
review_notes_zh: 審查通過：（1）GET /api/v1/lineage/inspiration/{artifact_id} 路由已正確實作；（2）response 欄位 artifact_id、inspiration_edges、strategy_tags、meta.snapshot_at、meta.surfaces.inspiration 全部對齊已發布 contract；（3）未知 artifact 即使 inspiration dataset 缺失時仍回 404（OBJECT_NOT_FOUND）；（4）已知 artifact 且 dataset missing 時回 200 with surfaces.inspiration=unavailable；（5）3/3 EW-04 contract tests 通過，5/5 PKT-003 regression tests 通過；僅既有 Pydantic dict() deprecation warning，非本 task 引入。

handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by Gemini while Claude completes higher-priority work.

EW-04 BFF route finalized for review: enforced 404 for unknown artifacts even when inspiration dataset is missing, added contract tests for published projection and unavailable surface, and synced EW-04 backlog/BFF contract status to route live. Verified with pytest -q services/control-plane/bff/test_ew04_inspiration_graph_contract.py and pytest -q services/control-plane/bff/test_pkt003_lineage_view_contract.py (all pass; only pre-existing Pydantic dict() deprecation warning remains).

Review approved: route matches published contract, 404 enforced for unknown artifacts even when dataset missing, all 3 EW-04 tests and 5 PKT-003 regressions pass. Returning to Codex2 for finalization.
